en: Monochrome printed postcard showing a small, old, steep‑roofed house standing alone in a cobbled square, with a horse and cart at its side. The building has a high, tiled hip roof, simple plastered walls, and small windows. Behind it rise taller townhouses and, in the background, the ornate tower and spire of a church or town hall. The style is Northern European and appears to be an architectural illustration rather than a photograph.
